summary: Only the source type, name and arguments are replaced by an event stream. The remaining activation fields match a normal activation: credentials (Vault, AAP, custom), decision environment (always pull), restart policy (Always, Never, On failure) and log level (Error, Info, Debug).
questions: Which parts of a rulebook does an event stream replace?
What restart policy should I use with event streams?
Can I set the pull policy for an activation's decision environment?
